paragraphs.text: Syrix , Carrier of the Flame is a Phoenix in New Capenna .

With wings alight in crimson and gold, eyes that burn with an intense, otherworldly fire, and a steel-clad body that makes it seem almost like a living sculpture, Syrix cuts a striking figure against the skyline of New Capenna. Its presence is heralded by a wave of heat and a flash of light, a clear sign that Syrix is near.
